data.narrative:
HyImpulse is a Series B-stage space and aerospace company that has raised €74 million to date. Valuation analysis draws on a peer set of five same-sector, same- or adjacent-stage private companies spanning Series B and Series C funding rounds, supplemented by reference to six publicly traded space and aerospace peers.

The peer-median method is the primary applicable approach. The five private comparables—Sierra Space ($8.0B, Series C), Cowboy Space Corporation ($2.0B, Series B), Varda Space Industries ($1.5B, Series C), Aalyria ($1.3B, Series B), and Skyryse ($1.1B, Series C)—yield a median valuation of $1.5B with a range of $1.1B to $8.0B. Public-comp anchoring via price-to-sales multiples is not applicable because HyImpulse's revenue is not on file; the sector median P/S across six public peers stands at 23.9x, but cannot be deployed without the target's revenue disclosure.

The triangulated valuation range is $1.3B (low) to $1.7B (high), centered on $1.5B. This narrow band reflects reliance on a single quantitative method and modest peer sample size. Key uncertainties include the appropriateness of Series C comparables in a median calculation and the absence of revenue or unit-economics data to stress-test or differentiate HyImpulse's position relative to peers.
